query: SELECT c.id, c.fullName, ca.currentBalanceUsd, ca.packageDebtUsd, ca.fullPackageDebtUsd FROM customers c LEFT JOIN customerAccounts ca ON c.id = ca.customerId WHERE CAST(ca.currentBalanceUsd AS DECIMAL(12,2)) > 0 LIMIT 5;
